$comment: Where each prayer's lines fall, for Shared/tools/reflow-prayers.py. A marker is a substring of the prayer; a line break goes immediately before it. Only whitespace changes — the tool refuses to run if collapsing the result back to spaces does not reproduce the original wording exactly.
$he: The Hebrew breaks are not editorial judgement. They are transcribed from the prayer sheets a woman from the Rosary Zoom call sent in August 2026 — the Latin-rite Vicariate's Hebrew, vocalised, as she prays it and as she laid it out for others to pray. Where her sheet sets a line, this sets a line. Her wording also matches the app's almost exactly, which is worth knowing on its own; the handful of places it does not are listed in the notes below and are for a person to settle, not this file.
